claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures the condition under which a private nonprofit entity must administer the CSBG program through a tripartite board that fully participates in development, planning, implementation, and evaluation.

Claim C0001 accurately covers the selection of board members by the private nonprofit entity, the requirement for 1/3 elected public officials (or their representatives), and the exception allowing appointive public officials when insufficient elected officials are available and willing to serve.

Claim C0002 captures the requirement for at least 1/3 low-income neighborhood representatives democratically selected, and the requirement that each representative reside in the neighborhood represented.

Claim C0003 correctly states that the remainder of the tripartite board members must be officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.

Claim C0004 completely and accurately covers the public organization requirements, including the option between a tripartite board meeting democratic selection and residency requirements and another mechanism specified by the State.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 fully retains the requirement and condition for private nonprofit entities to administer the CSBG program through a fully participating tripartite board.
Claim C0001 explicitly states that board members shall be selected by the entity.
Claim C0001 explicitly retains the composition rule requiring one-third of board members to be elected public officials holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives.
Claim C0001 explicitly retains the exception allowing appointive public officials or their representatives to count if reasonably available elected officials are fewer than one-third.
Claim C0002 includes the requirement that not fewer than one-third of members be chosen via democratic selection procedures adequate to assure representation of low-income individuals and families.
Claim C0002 explicitly incorporates the requirement that low-income representative members must reside in the specific neighborhood represented.
Claim C0003 fully covers the requirement that the remainder of the members are representatives of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups.
Claim C0004 covers the condition for public organizations to administer the program through either a tripartite board or a State-specified mechanism.
Claim C0004 fully retains the tripartite board branch for public organizations, including democratic selection, low-income representation, residency, and active participation.
Claim C0004 fully retains the alternative mechanism branch specified by the State for decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals.
